```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/ajl21/github/division.labor/System_validation/")

data<-  read_excel("20261124_1622_systemvalidation_sporulation.xlsx")

cfu_function <- function(data) {
  data$cfu <- data$Colony / (10^(-data$Diluation) * data$Volume)
  data[c("Strain", "cfu", "Type", "Replicate")]
}

cfu_table <- cfu_function(data)

average_cfu <- function(data) {
  aggregate(cfu ~ Strain + Type +Replicate, data = cfu_table, FUN = mean)
}

averages <- average_cfu(cfu_table)


ggplot(averages, aes(x=Strain, y=cfu)) +
    geom_boxplot() +facet_wrap(~Type, labeller = labeller(Type = 
    c("SPO" = "SPOIIE",
      "WT" = "Wild-Type")))+ theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) 

ggplot(averages, aes(x = Strain, y = cfu)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Type, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(Type = c("SPO" = "SPOIIE",
                                          "WT"  = "Wild-Type"))) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = 10^(0:7), labels = label_scientific()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
                   breaks = c(0, 10^(2:7)),
                   labels = label_scientific())

```


```{r}
base_theme <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
  plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11)
)

p_spo <- averages %>%
  filter(Type == "SPO") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Strain, y = cfu)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  labs(title = "SPOIIE", y = "cfu") +
  base_theme

p_wt <- averages %>%
  filter(Type == "WT") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Strain, y = cfu)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = 10^(5:8), labels = label_scientific()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(5e4, 1e8)) +
  labs(title = "Wild-Type", y = NULL) +
  base_theme

p_spo + p_wt
```
